title: The Code Behind the Layout: AI Agents for Analog Layout Generators
abstract: arXiv:2610.38426v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Analog layout remains largely manual and hard to automate. Generator frameworks such as gLayout express layouts as programs, producing layouts from parameterized, design-rule-aware generators; however, writing such generators still takes expert effort. Large language models (LLMs) could now write generator code, and frontier models can even draw layout geometry from design intent. This raises a practical question: if a model can draw the layout itself, what does a generator framework still contribute, and is applying these models to a generator framework better than having them draw a layout from scratch? Through controlled experiments on gLayout in SKY130, we find that the main obstacle to drawing a layout directly is its time and token cost, and that the main advantage of a model building on a generator framework is reusability. Its verified primitives keep each model edit small enough to check, and its parameters allow a single edit

translated_title: 布局背后的代码：面向模拟版图生成器的AI智能体
translated_abstract: 模拟版图设计在很大程度上仍然依赖人工，且难以自动化。gLayout等生成器框架将版图表达为程序，通过参数化、遵循设计规则的生成器来产生版图；然而，编写这样的生成器仍需要专家投入大量精力。大型语言模型（LLM）如今已经能够编写生成器代码，前沿模型甚至可以根据设计意图直接绘制版图几何图形。这引出了一个实际问题：如果模型本身就能绘制版图，那么生成器框架还能贡献什么？将模型应用于生成器框架，是否比让它们从头绘制版图更好？通过在SKY130工艺上对gLayout进行的受控实验，我们发现直接绘制版图的主要障碍在于其时间和令牌成本，而模型基于生成器框架构建的主要优势在于可复用性。经过验证的基础元件使模型的每次修改都足够小、便于检查，其参数化特性则允许单次修改即可实现（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究通过在SKY130工艺上的受控实验发现，让大模型直接绘制模拟版图的主要瓶颈是时间和令牌成本，而基于生成器框架构建AI智能体的核心优势在于可复用性——经过验证的基础元件使每次修改便于检查，参数化使单次编辑即可高效复用。
en_tdlr: Through controlled experiments on gLayout in SKY130, this paper shows that the main obstacle to having LLMs draw analog layouts directly is time and token cost, while building AI agents on generator frameworks offers the key advantage of reusability, as verified primitives keep each model edit small enough to check and parameters enable a single edit to be leveraged repeatedly.
